responsibility: Defines the user-visible target options for the Moxie port and maps them onto backend masks. This option table introduces endianness selection switches, enables the optional MUL.X instruction subset, and carries the target-only mno-crt0 flag used by startup-file specs, allowing GCC’s option machinery to set the Moxie-specific target flags consumed by headers, hooks, and machine-description conditionals.
same_name_distinction: Declares the Moxie-specific target command-line options and maps them to backend masks such as LITTLE_ENDIAN and HAS_MULX, which are then tested by moxie.h, moxie.cc, and moxie.md; unlike the other same-stem files, this file is only option metadata rather than target macros, hook implementations, or instruction patterns.
